response.justification: Bogdan brings a long and varied engineering career (roughly 15 years of professional experience across web, mobile, embedded, and high-throughput backend systems) plus founder experience with an open-source geo-data platform, which partially satisfies the minimum bar. However, the role is a director-level individual contributor focused on AI strategy, requiring recognized AI expertise, demonstrated AI products/platforms, deep cloud-platform fluency, and executive-level influence with strategic customers and partners. The resume shows only nascent AI exposure (MCP tooling and agent infrastructure since 2025), limited cloud architecture depth beyond AWS CDK and Kubernetes deployment, and no evidence of strategy, advisory, or organization-level technical leadership. The gap between a hands-on staff/senior IC profile and a principal AI strategist is substantial.
strengths: ~15 years of broad, hands-on engineering across web, mobile, embedded, and low-latency systems
Founder of an open-source platform plus strong community presence via talks, workshops, and OSS libraries
Early practical exposure to agentic AI tooling (MCP generators, agent frameworks) and strong engineering craft (TDD, CI/CD)
concerns: No demonstrated AI/ML expertise, research background, or shipped AI products at scale
Lacks director-level scope: no strategy, customer/partner advisory, or cross-org technical leadership evidence
Limited cloud-platform depth; profile reads as senior/staff IC rather than principal-level industry authority

key_factors.factor: AI expertise and demonstrated AI products
Seniority/scope mismatch for director-level IC strategy role
Breadth of engineering experience and founder/OSS background
